about: Models allowed in this project (brief §4e, principle 3). Each records its license and whether its weights are open; open-weight models are preferred. A model is added only by a reviewed change that quotes the license line from the model's own card, and only if that license clearly allows publishing outputs under GPL-3.0. The composer offers only these; every recipe records the exact model and revision. Hosted models run on a third party's servers; for them the recipe's model record is the endpoint, the date and the host's request id. Local models stay preferred when they can do the job.

models.notes: Speech-to-speech: a person's performance spoken in a voice sheet's voice. Part of the Chatterbox release ('Easy voice conversion script'); Chatterbox applies the Perth watermark to every output, though Perth's detector can't confirm it (it scores clean speech as watermarked; test of 2026-10-14). The performer agrees to own-voice-v1 first. Performed takes are converted locally (chatterbox-tts, MIT, in .venv-voice) so a raw take never leaves the performer's machine; the hosted endpoint is used for a take only if its performer agrees (owner, 2026-10-13). Raw takes are never published; the recipe records their sha256.

models.notes: NOT USED (owner, 2026-10-15: 'we're using v3 from fal'; the local run was stopped to free the Mac). Approved by the owner on 2026-10-15 for the Dreadnaught clip (instrumental, a wordless scream). The card: 'You can strictly use the generated music for commercial purposes', trained on 'Professionally licensed music tracks'. Uses the 2B turbo DiT (acestep-v15-turbo), its VAE, and two component models with their own lines: Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (text encoder, 'license: apache-2.0', revision as bundled in this repo; upstream 97b0c614) and ACE-Step/acestep-5Hz-lm-0.6B (the planning language model, 'license: mit', revision 148d8ea0225bdab342ee1ae3a354275ccd60ca80). The 1.7B language model in the repo is not used. Runs from the ACE-Step-1.5 code (MIT, github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5 at ca1e85fe), kept outside the repository. Prompts describe qualities; no artist or band is named.
